significance: One of Ayodhya's principal shrines, housing images of Rama and Sita in a palace-like building rebuilt in 1891 by Maharani Vrishabhan Kunwari and Maharaj Mahendra Pratap Singh. Its form deliberately echoes the palaces of Rajasthan and Bundelkhand.
story: Tradition holds that Kaikeyi gave this golden mansion to Rama and Sita as their private residence immediately after their marriage.
